answer: Duplicating identities means re-buying hardware, re-staking bonds, and redoing compute per fake node, so a sybil swarm's cost scales linearly while honest single agents pay once—making forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged bond locked to a unique device fingerprint, and every epoch it solves a fresh proof-of-work tied to the prior epoch's dune-seeded randomness, like a river whose current changes each season. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
